name: Transition Pattern
description: To represent basic knowledge about transitions (events, states, processes, objects).
scenarios: The addition of Bud Powell on piano made the tune jump from a static, aerial comping into a hard driving swing improvisation
competency_questions: What states of some object are changed by what event during a transition?,What is the process that is invariant through the transition?,What transitions are occurring on what object at what time?
